premises: Slow reaction kinetics in conventional synthesis lead to phase segregation in HENAs
Laser-induced thermionic emission reduction is an ultrafast synthesis method
Ultrafast synthesis kinetically suppresses atomic diffusion and phase nucleation
Kinetic suppression preserves high configurational entropy and prevents segregation
